criteria.silhouette_scale: Single squat bearing assembly; feet, collar and shaft remain distinct at native size.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Static inventory sprite fits the generated-item route.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Shaft enters the central copper collar; housing and mounting feet form one supported assembly.
criteria.period_materials: Cool cast housing, machined steel shaft and functional copper bearing fit town industry.
criteria.family_consistency: Uses engine cool metal and warm fittings, with coarse resource-sprite clusters.
criteria.controls_readability: No controls; copper collar distinguishes this manufactured intermediate.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Existing item and steel/copper recipe retained.

criteria.matches_direction: Housing arch, copper collar, shaft and mounting feet survive the 28-pixel silhouette.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Native generated item uses one 32x32 RGBA texture, binary alpha and 16 opaque colors.
criteria.material_consistency: Cool steel has broad varied planes; copper remains a functional accent.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Existing machine_parts resource identity retained. No block interfaces.
criteria.native_size_readability: Native dark/light views retain separated collar and shaft with clean padded silhouette.

criteria.photon_materials: Photon shades framed/held steel darker than inventory, with collar and shaft still distinct.
criteria.scale_readability: Bearing silhouette and warm collar read in hotbar, creative slots and frames.
criteria.states_motion: Static generated item, ordinary held transform; no animated states.
criteria.interaction_guides: Material item has no placement guide or controls.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Compared beside steel, sulfur and Cloth: cool low-saturation housing contrasts yellow mineral and pale fabric; comparable icon scale, restrained highlights and deliberate clusters fit the family. Existing steel uses a thinner 3D model.
criteria.integration_limits: Build/unit and parts visual scene passed; inspected inventory, held and frame screenshots. No gameplay changes or multiplayer claims.
